narrative.overview: Coach For All is the owner's purple-and-gold prototype taken all the way through the app. Deep aubergine is the shell and the one colour you can press. Gold marks quality and time: ratings, the confirmation tick, and the start times on Home's departures board. The ground is plain white, so photos and the aubergine carry the colour, not tinted backgrounds.
keyCharacteristics: An aubergine Home band and a night-aubergine departures board at full strength, never a pale tint.
One action colour: aubergine fills mean "press me"; selection uses the same aubergine.
Gold is for quality and time, never for buttons.
Playfair Display for brand moments (wordmark, greetings, confirmations); the system font for everything you read and tap.
Class name first and large, instructor small under it; price only on Review & pay.

rules.name: The One Action Colour Rule
rules.body: Aubergine fill means pressable or chosen. Never use it for decoration.

rules.name: The Gold Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Gold marks quality (rating, verified, confirmed) and start times. It is never a button, and never text on white.

rules.name: The Full Strength Rule
rules.body: The band and the board are solid aubergine. Never a gradient, never a pale wash.

rules.name: The Class First Rule
rules.body: The class name is the large line; the instructor's name is smaller and sits under it.

rules.name: The Time Leads Rule
rules.body: On booking cards and the board, the start time is the largest, boldest thing.

rules.name: The Glass Is Apple's Rule
rules.body: Liquid Glass is for system chrome and for controls over photos (overMedia). Content is never glass.

dos: Do use aubergine (#3b0a6b) for every primary action and selection, and nothing else.
Do put the class name first and large, with the instructor smaller under it.
Do keep prices off cards, Book and the Group page. Price first appears on Review & pay.
Do mark dates on a month calendar with gold dots.
Do take every value from @cfa/tokens. Screens hold no raw hex.
donts: Don't put a small label (kicker) above a heading. Make the heading carry it, or turn it into a button (Book again).
Don't make buttons and options look alike. Buttons are filled or outlined pills; options are chips.
Don't use gold for buttons, or as text on white.
Don't tint the ground grey or lavender. The ground stays white (#ffffff), and colour comes from the band, the board, photos and aubergine.
Don't put content in glass. Glass is for Apple's chrome and for controls over photos.
